subtitle: Example report for a fictional system. Revision `4f1c2ab` on `main`, 2026-11-02, full assessment, read-only. Click a section chip or a diagram box to jump; open "Details" panels for evidence.

verdict.lede: The modular monolith is fit for purpose for the declared workload of a few hundred orders per day. One risk needs action now: payment capture and order state commit in separate transactions, so a timeout after capture can leave a paid order marked unpaid. The first move is a small outbox for the capture call, not a new service.
decisions: Whether a paid order may stay unconfirmed for up to five minutes; this sets the outbox retry window.

findings.lede: One root cause: the payment effect and the order state have no shared commit.

items.title: Payment capture and order commit are not atomic
items.summary: A timeout after capture leaves a paid order unpaid. Record capture intent in the order transaction and deliver it from an outbox. No lost payments; retry-safe.
items.decision: End-to-end correctness fails across the capture timeout window, because the capture call and the order commit run in separate transactions (E001).
items.observation: `checkout()` captures, then opens a new transaction to mark the order paid.
items.impact: A provider timeout after capture charges the customer without a paid order (Q1).
items.recommendation: Write a capture intent row with the order and deliver it with an idempotency key; this restores end-to-end correctness at the cost of one table and one worker.
items.alternatives: Keep as is and reconcile by hand from provider reports; acceptable only below a few incidents per month.
items.when_not: The provider guarantees synchronous capture results with no timeout path.
items.acceptance: A test that times out the provider after capture ends with exactly one paid order and one capture.
items.rollback: Disable the worker and drain the outbox by hand; captured payments need reconciliation, not rollback.

items.text: One writer module for order state.

respected: ADR-003 keeps one deployable until a second team exists; the review agrees.

options.lede: Keep the monolith and add an outbox for payment capture; Q1 decides it.

steps.text: Add the capture outbox; accept when the timeout test passes; roll back by disabling the worker.
